Shown by superposition, symmetry or schematic, not as deposited

  • Panels A and B are drawn as deposited.
  • Panel C places psilocin (7WC5) by rigid-body superposition on the serotonin entry (7WC4): 281 receptor Cα, 0.37 Å RMSD, with the engineered fusion domain excluded (363 Cα including it give 0.39 Å). The static plate and the interactive viewer state the same figure.
  • Panel D places the Gi1 complex (9LL8) by rigid-body superposition on the mini-Gq complex (9AS8): 258 receptor Cα, 0.68 Å RMSD.
  • The dephosphorylation step has no structure. No entry contains the phosphatase that performs it, and none holds psilocybin and psilocin together. It appears only as the step between panels A and B; it is not drawn as a structure.
  • The plate states no use of crystallographic symmetry. Nothing is docked, rebuilt or minimised.

What the coordinates support, and what they do not

  • Prodrug and metabolite are not the same object. The molecule administered, psilocybin, carries a 4-phosphoryloxy group that is removed before the molecule engages a receptor. Every receptor structure holds the dephosphorylated metabolite, psilocin. Psilocybin's only deposited atoms are in the fungal enzyme in panel A. No deposited structure holds psilocybin bound to any human receptor.
  • A settled pocket. Only the residues contacted in all independent depositions are counted as contacts. Six 5-HT2A entries reduce to four independent depositions, because 9AS7/9AS8 and 22WP/9WND are each one particle set refined locally and globally. Across those four, only Asp155 and Phe339 are contacted in all of them, out of a union of eighteen pocket residues. Residues contacted in some depositions and not others are drawn in mid grey and are not a settled pocket.
  • Gq against Gi. In panel D the mini-Gq and Gi1 α5 helices reach the same site: their tips lie 0.59 Å apart, with the receptor differing by 0.68 Å. These coordinates do not distinguish Gq from Gi coupling. The Gq construct is additionally a chimera. The ligand sits 32.3 Å away, at the opposite face.
  • Receptor-subtype selectivity. Psilocin is deposited at 5-HT2A and once at 5-HT2C (8DPG), and at no other serotonin receptor. One structure per receptor cannot support a selectivity claim.
  • Mechanism only. No efficacy claim, no therapy comparison and no clinical inference is made or implied by the plate or by this page.

Where the plate and the archive differ

  • No open difference. The plate's citations, including Cao et al., Science 2022 for 7WC4 and 7WC5, agree with the archive's primary citations read for this page. The plate also names 6WGT (Kim et al., Cell 2020) as verified and not rendered; it is not drawn and is not listed above.
  • Whose numbers these are. The distances, alignment errors and contact sets are the plate's own computations from coordinates retrieved on 2026-10-14, recomputed from the deposited coordinates in the figure-integrity pass of 2026-10-15, where every COMP360 figure reproduced as stated. This page re-read each entry's contents, method, resolution, release date and primary citation from the archive. It did not recompute the superpositions itself.
